scene:
Three zones read left to right.

LEFT ZONE: two simple abstract rounded blob shapes side by side (not real country outlines), the right one marked with a teal flag on a pole and a small calendar beside it; one label under it: SECOND COUNTRY IN 12 MONTHS. A thick navy arrow leads right to the middle zone.

MIDDLE ZONE, in two parts, with no heading above it.
Upper part: a hub diagram. In the centre, a large navy-outlined box with a gear icon, labelled INVOICING; inside the box a small ochre scroll labelled COUNTRY RULES. Three smaller boxes around it, each with a thin arrow pointing FROM the small box TO the central box (they read the rules there): a document with a signature line labelled CONTRACTS on the upper left, a headset labelled SUPPORT on the upper right, a slider panel labelled SETTINGS below. In front of the central box stands a narrow gate with exactly two people standing in it, labelled TWO SPECIALISTS.
Lower part: two horizontal bars starting at the same left edge, like a timing chart: a long ochre bar labelled REQUEST TO LIVE: 3 WEEKS, and beneath it a very short teal bar labelled COMMIT TO LIVE: UNDER 2 DAYS.
A thick navy arrow leads right to the right zone.

RIGHT ZONE: a large clipboard labelled FINDING at its top. On the clipboard, three rows, each an icon with its label: a teal shield labelled STRENGTHS TO KEEP; an ochre price tag labelled REPLACEMENT €1.3M OVER 18 MONTHS; a calendar with one circled page labelled FIRST INVOICES: MONTH 12 AT EARLIEST.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: SECOND COUNTRY IN 12 MONTHS, INVOICING, COUNTRY RULES, CONTRACTS, SUPPORT, SETTINGS, TWO SPECIALISTS, REQUEST TO LIVE: 3 WEEKS, COMMIT TO LIVE: UNDER 2 DAYS, FINDING, STRENGTHS TO KEEP, REPLACEMENT €1.3M OVER 18 MONTHS, FIRST INVOICES: MONTH 12 AT EARLIEST. Calendars, maps, documents and the clipboard carry no other writing or numbers. No zone titles or headings. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A plan for a second country within twelve months leads to the evidence: country rules sit in the invoicing module that contracts, support and settings all read, every change passes two specialists, and a change takes three weeks from request to live against under two days from commit to live; the finding keeps the strengths and prices a replacement at €1.3 million over eighteen months with first invoices at month twelve at the earliest.
caption: From what the plan needs to a finding: the evidence, the constraint, the strengths worth keeping and what a transition would cost.
